create.name: Pea Horsley
create.bio:
Pea Horsley is a London-based animal communicator and teacher who works telepathically with animals and teaches others to do the same. She spent fifteen years as a theatre stage manager before adopting her first dog, Morgan; a workshop she joined to understand him better convinced her that two-way contact with animals was possible, and she changed careers. She went on to study with Amelia Kinkade and at the College of Psychic Studies, and has also trained in Reiki, shamanic journeying and past-life work.

Her teaching rests on a five-step method she calls Heart to Heart: quietening the body and mind, then sending and receiving impressions with an animal. She teaches it through self-paced online courses, a live membership community called The Pride, one-to-one mentoring for practising communicators, recorded guided journeys with wild species, and small-group retreats in places such as Namibia and Indonesia. Hay House has published two of her books, Animal Communication Made Easy and a guide to accompanying animals through loss, and HarperCollins her memoir Heart to Heart. Her work also covers the end of an animal's life and staying in touch with animals who have died.

books.title: Animal Communication Made Easy
books.author: Pea Horsley
books.description: A practical handbook that walks readers through calming body and mind and then her five-step approach to exchanging impressions with animals. Exercises, affirmations and meditations support each stage.

books.title: The Animal Communicator's Guide Through Life, Loss and Love
books.author: Pea Horsley
books.description: Written as her own dog Morgan neared the end of his life, it looks at how animals see dying and what they ask of their people. It includes messages from animals who have died and suggestions for grieving and remembering.

books.title: Heart to Heart
books.author: Pea Horsley
books.description: Her first book, a memoir of leaving theatre work after a rescue dog led her to animal communication. It follows her from doubt to practice through stories of real consultations.

courses.title: Sacred Kinship with the Animal Kingdom
courses.description: An on-demand course of seven modules in which she teaches her five-step telepathic method with an emphasis on respect for each animal's own view. It is offered through The Shift Network and linked from her own courses page.

courses.title: Communications with Animals
courses.description: Eight recorded guided journeys, each meeting a different species such as dolphins, elephants, bears or insects. Listeners are invited to imagine the animal's world and hear what it has to say.

courses.title: Grounding with Grace Meditations
courses.description: Three downloadable guided meditations for deep rest and calm, in which different animals appear as guides. They are meant as a regular reset to feel connected with all of life.

courses.title: In-The-Flow Professional Mentoring
courses.description: A three-session one-to-one programme for people who already communicate with animals and want more trust in what they receive. Pea shapes each session around the student's own blocks and goals.

courses.title: The Pride Membership
courses.description: A live, participatory online community for deepening a relationship with animals and the natural world alongside other members. Doors reopen in spring 2027, with a waitlist open now.

free_resources.title: Free Resources: tele-classes and interviews
free_resources.description: A page of free audio from her site, including tele-classes on talking with wild animals, a guided meditation and radio interviews. It is a good introduction to how she works.
